summary: Architectural plan for the Interactive 3D 4×4 Rubik's Cube Solver & Step-by-Step Guide, detailing Three.js 3D rendering with procedural cubies and animated turn arrows, 4x4 reduction solving engine with OLL/PLL parity handling, interactive direct-click 3D and 2D sticker color editor, step-by-step physical practice mode, and local state persistence.
